name: forearm_sleeve_end
where: Dark-blue coat sleeve running into the gold cuff from the elbow side. Left: x<0.74 at y~0.70-0.78; right: x>0.20 mirrored.
shape: Wrinkled blue tube that bunches and tucks under the gold cuff.
notes: Sleeve is under the cuff. Right sleeve shows deeper diagonal folds (clay, ft panel). Sleeve is probably surveyed by the upper-arm region; listed here as the boundary.

name: bracer_gold_cuff_band
where: Wide gold ring at the elbow end of the bracer. Left: x 0.745-0.785, y 0.71-0.775 (front). Right: x 0.16-0.20, y 0.71-0.775.
shape: Wide plain gold cylindrical band with a thin raised lip along each edge; tilted slightly to follow the arm.
in_reference: yes: big gold cuff band, same place
notes: Sits over the sleeve and next to the dark bracer tube. The top plate overlaps its inner edge. Worn orange-copper paint on the bottom, which is paint only.

name: cuff_band_studs
where: Left forearm front: one larger dome at about (0.755,0.735) and 2-3 smaller domes at about (0.756,0.720), (0.762,0.716), plus a tiny one by the lower edge (bottom view). Right forearm front: dome at about (0.185,0.737), small domes near (0.19,0.727), (0.178,0.716), (0.19,0.71).
shape: Small gold domed rivets scattered in a loose cluster on the face of the band.
in_reference: differs: reference shows 3 evenly placed studs in a row on the cuff
notes: Count is roughly 3-4 per side with irregular sizes and spacing. Left and right clusters are mirror-ish but not identical. Could be remodelled as a regular set of 3.

name: bracer_leather_tube
where: Dark near-black/blue-grey tube between the gold cuff and the wrist. Left: x 0.775-0.85; right: x 0.09-0.16.
shape: Slightly tapering cylinder, wider at the cuff and narrower at the wrist, with a smooth surface.
notes: Under the top plate and straps. A mid raised ring strap sits on it next to the cuff.

name: bracer_ring_strap
where: Raised dark ring just inside the gold cuff. Left: x~0.775-0.785, y 0.715-0.755 (front); right: x~0.15-0.16.
shape: Narrow raised band that goes around the tube, with a groove at each edge.
in_reference: yes: reference shows strap bands on the bracer
notes: Could be an extension of the cuff lip rather than a separate strap. Sits on the tube, under the top plate.

name: bracer_top_plate
where: Plate on the upper (dorsal) side of the forearm. Left: x 0.755-0.835, y up to 0.785 at the cuff end falling to 0.745 at the wrist end. Right: x 0.095-0.185.
shape: Tapered rectangular plate with a raised gold rim, high and curved at the cuff end, and narrower and square-ended toward the wrist.
in_reference: differs: reference shows no separate plate, only flat gold bands
notes: Sits over the leather tube and overlaps the inner edge of the cuff. Dark blue face with gold painted scratches (paint only). Left and right are mirror images.

name: top_plate_rim_trim
where: Perimeter of the top plate, with a notch/step on the cuff side.
shape: Raised gold lip following the plate outline in an L shape along the cuff end and the long edge.
notes: May be one piece with the plate. Listed separately because of its colour and height.

name: top_plate_studs
where: Left top view: 2 at the cuff end (about (0.765,0.763) and lower corner), 2 at the wrist end (about (0.826,0.745) and one more). Right: mirrored, e.g. (0.17,0.762), (0.098,0.74).
shape: Gold domed rivets at the plate corners.
notes: Count is 4 per plate from the top view, but only 2 are seen in the front view.

name: top_plate_arc_ridge
where: Top view, near the cuff end of the plate; left around (0.77-0.79 x, mid z).
shape: Crescent/D-shaped raised bead or embossed handle bow, open toward the wrist.
notes: Could be sculpted fold of the plate rather than a separate piece.

name: wrist_strap
where: Dark strap near the wrist end, just below the plate. Left: x~0.825-0.845, y 0.715-0.74. Right: x~0.095-0.115.
shape: Raised band around the tube with a stepped edge toward the glove.
in_reference: yes: reference shows a strap at the wrist
notes: Under the plate's wrist end. Left strap has a small tab or buckle-like notch on the front (front panel near (0.835,0.727)).

name: wrist_strap_studs
where: Left: 2 on the front face near (0.828,0.722) and (0.833,0.727), 1 on the back/underside; right: 2-3 near (0.10,0.725), (0.11,0.73) and underside.
shape: Small gold domes in a short row or triangle.
notes: Count differs by view. Could be 3 per side.

name: glove_wrist_cuff
shape: Short dark glove cuff flaring slightly from the bracer end, with a rolled edge.
notes: Under the wrist strap. Right-hand glove cuff is partly cropped.

name: glove_back_of_hand
where: Left hand: x 0.86-0.92, y 0.70-0.75 (hand_l back panel).
shape: Smooth panel over the metacarpals with a faint knuckle bump row.
notes: Right hand is the mirror and not photographed beyond the forearm_r views.

name: glove_knuckle_welt_seam
where: Diagonal raised line across the back of the hand near the wrist, about x 0.88-0.91, y 0.70-0.745; the same seam shows on the palm side.
shape: Narrow raised welt/ridge separating the cuff section from the hand section.
notes: Could be modelled as an edge seam or a thin strip.

name: glove_palm_pad
where: Left palm at the thumb base, about x 0.86-0.89, y 0.71-0.75 (hand_l front/fr).
shape: Rounded thenar pad outlined by a curved seam line.
notes: Seam is crisp enough to be a separate stitched piece.

name: glove_fingers
where: Left: fingers fan from x~0.90 to 0.93, y 0.68-0.74.
shape: Rounded tubes of 3 segments each, separated by shallow creases.
notes: Fingers have flat open or ragged ends (scan holes) at the tips. Fingertips need closing.

name: glove_thumb
where: Left: tip at about (0.89,0.765) pointing up/away.
shape: 2-segment tapered tube with a crease at the joint and rounded tip.

name: glove_finger_segment_creases
where: At joints of each finger and the thumb.
notes: Likely sculpted creases; segment edges could be separate seams in a game model.

name: missing_stitching_and_buckle
shape: Reference character sheet bracer shows tight straps and a buckled dark lower bracer; the sculpt shows a plain tube.
notes: The sculpt lacks these. The top plate in the sculpt has no clear match in the reference.
